related.title: 大型風機複合材料葉片製造
related.titleEn: Large Wind Turbine Composite Blade Manufacturing
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大型風機複合材料葉片製造的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Large Wind Turbine Composite Blade Manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦陸域風機的支撐結構：塔筒壁應力與運輸限制、重力式基礎的偏心與錨栓拉力；大型風機複合材料葉片製造則以百公尺級葉片的製造：纖維體積比與剛度、真空灌注、模具產能、全尺寸疲勞試驗與防雷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on support structure of an onshore turbine: tower-wall stress and transport limits, eccentricity of a gravity foundation and anchor-bolt tension; Large Wind Turbine Composite Blade Manufacturing centres on making hundred-metre blades: fibre fraction and stiffness, vacuum infusion, mould output, full-scale fatigue testing and lightning protection, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「結構自然頻率與 1P、3P」的模型移到大型風機複合材料葉片製造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全尺寸疲勞試驗的天數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Structural natural frequency and 1P, 3P" to Large Wind Turbine Composite Blade Manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Days of a full-scale fatigue test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大型風機複合材料葉片製造的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Large Wind Turbine Composite Blade Manufacturing must be respecified.

related.title: 阿爾塔風能中心
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；阿爾塔風能中心的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Alta Wind Energy Center must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦陸域風機的支撐結構：塔筒壁應力與運輸限制、重力式基礎的偏心與錨栓拉力；阿爾塔風能中心則以山口地形上的美國大型陸域風場：地形加速、500 kV 外送與老風場的更新為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on support structure of an onshore turbine: tower-wall stress and transport limits, eccentricity of a gravity foundation and anchor-bolt tension; Alta Wind Energy Center centres on A large US onshore wind farm in a mountain pass: terrain speed-up, 500 kV export and repowering of old sites, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「掃掠面積與比功率」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「結構自然頻率與 1P、3P」的模型移到阿爾塔風能中心，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾流虧損與機組間距」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Swept area and specific power" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Structural natural frequency and 1P, 3P" to Alta Wind Energy Center, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wake deficit and turbine spacing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「轉子推力與塔基彎矩」與「風速誤差與功率不確定度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；阿爾塔風能中心的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Rotor thrust and tower-base moment" and "Wind-speed error and power uncertainty" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Alta Wind Energy Center must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 陸域風機塔筒與基礎耦合
history.titleEn: Onshore Wind Turbine Tower and Foundation Coupling
history.text: 1980 年早期風機採桁架塔與小型基礎；2000 年鋼製圓筒塔成為主流；2010 年混合塔進入量產；2020 年輪轂高度超過 160 m 的機型商業化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1980: Early turbines used lattice towers and small foundations. 2000: Tubular steel towers became standard. 2010: Hybrid towers entered series production. 2020: Models with hub heights above 160 m became commercial. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
